question: Did the bottom-right girl appear in exactly five outfits?
pred:
Evidence: The bottom-right girl appears in four distinct outfits throughout the video: 1) a beige t-shirt and striped shorts (frames 1-33 and 46-49), 2) a black outfit with a fur accessory (frames 34-38), 3) a white sleeveless top and denim shorts (frames 39-42), and 4) a white top with a black skirt and cap (frames 43-45). Although she appears in five outfit *segments* (returning to the first outfit at the end), there are only four distinct outfits.
Answer: No
